title: Search Not Working
description: Fix WordPress search returning no results, wrong results, or search plugins conflicting with default search behavior.

steps.title: Identify Search Failure Scope
steps.instructions: Test default ?s= query, theme search form, and any search plugin (SearchWP, Relevanssi). Note if all post types fail or only custom types.

steps.title: Flush Permalinks
steps.instructions: Broken rewrite rules can break search URLs. Save Settings → Permalinks without changes.

steps.title: Check Search Exclusion Plugins
steps.instructions: SEO plugins, members-only plugins, and Search Exclude may hide posts from search. Review exclusion settings per post type.

steps.title: Include Custom Post Types in Search
steps.instructions: Default WordPress search only queries posts. Add CPTs via search plugin, theme functions, or pre_get_posts filter. Verify CPT posts are published.

steps.title: Rebuild Search Index (If Using Search Plugin)
steps.instructions: SearchWP, Relevanssi, and ElasticPress need index rebuilds after imports. Run full reindex from plugin settings.

steps.title: Exclude Search from Page Cache
steps.instructions: Cached search result pages serve stale or empty results. Exclude ?s= and /search/ URLs from full-page cache rules.

steps.title: Verify Theme search.php Template
steps.instructions: A broken or missing search.php template may show blank results even when posts match. Test with a default theme on staging.

steps.title: Test Search with Known Content
steps.instructions: Search for unique words in published posts, pages, and products. Confirm results appear and pagination works.
